```{r, echo=FALSE}
# cis-eQTL
# --------
#   group:
#     AA (African American)
#     PR (Puerto Rican)
#     MX (Mexican American)
#     All (Pooled)
#     AFRHp5 (AFR high)
#     AFRLow (AFR low) 
#     IAMHp5 (IAM high)
#     IAMLow (IAM low)
# 
# 
# gene_id: gene ID from GENCODE v30
#   variant_id: variant ID in dbsnp150 or chr:pos:ref:alt(b38) format
#   tss_distance: distance between variant_ID and TSS of gene
#   ma_samples: number of samples that contains the minor allele
#   ma_count: minor allele count
#   maf: minor allele frequency
#   pval_nominal: p-value
#   slope: effect size relative to the alternative allele
#   slope_se: standard error of the effeice size
#   qval: per-gene qvalue (BH corection) calculated from beta-approximated p-value
#   pval_nominal_threshold: per-gene nominal p-value threshold as described in https://github.com/francois-a/fastqtl/blob/master/doc/pages/cis_permutation.html
#   eQTL.flag: TRUE (is an eQTL) if pval_nominal < pval_nominal_threhold
#   vid2: variant ID in the format of chr<chr>_<position>_<ref>_<alt>_b38
```

#convert rsID into chr:pos:ref:alt
# we can use biomaRt package or query resources like Ensembl's API to convert rsIDs into chr:pos:ref:alt for the hg38 genome build
#If biomaRt is slow or unavailable, you can query Ensembl's REST API directly. Here's an example using the httr package:
```{r, echo=FALSE}
 library(biomaRt)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
#Step 1: Load the file:

# Step 2: Identify rsIDs
rsid_rows <- grepl("^rs[0-9]+$", eqtl$variant_id)

# Extract rsIDs for processing
rsids <- eqtl$variant_id[rsid_rows]
rsids <- as.list(rsids)
#step 3
rsID="rs6898675"
fetch_variant_data <- function(rsID) {

  url <- paste0("https://rest.ensembl.org/variation/human/", rsID, "?content-type=application/json")
  response <- GET(url)

  # Check if the response is valid
  if (status_code(response) == 200) {
    data <- fromJSON(content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
    
  # Check if the response contains a 'mappings' field
    if (!is.null(data$mappings) && length(data$mappings) > 0) {
      mapping <- data$mappings # Use the first mapping
      if (is.list(mapping) && "allele_string" %in% names(mapping)) {
        alleles <- strsplit(mapping$allele_string, "/")[[1]]
       chr_pos_ref_alt <- paste0("chr", mapping$seq_region_name, ":", mapping$start, ":", alleles[1], ":", alleles[2])
        return(c(rsID, chr_pos_ref_alt))
      }
    }
  }
  
 # Log error for missing data
  return(c(rsID, NA))  # Return original rsID with NA for missing data
}

# Step 4: Query rsIDs in the file
result <- t(sapply(rsids, fetch_variant_data, USE.NAMES = FALSE))

# Step 5: Replace rsIDs in the original data with chr:pos:ref:alt
result_df <- as.data.frame(result, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(result_df) <- c("rsID", "chr_pos_ref_alt")

# Step 6: Save updated data to a new file
write.table(result_df, "updated_file.txt", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t")


```

Function to query rsID
https://rest.ensembl.org/variation/human/rs6886059/?content-type=application/json
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Function to query rsID
fetch_variant_data <- function(rsID) {
  url <- paste0("https://rest.ensembl.org/variation/human/", rsID, "?content-type=application/json")
  response <- GET(url)
  if (status_code(response) == 200) {
    data <- fromJSON(content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
    if (length(data$mappings) > 0) {
      mapping <- data$mappings[[1]]
      alleles <- strsplit(mapping$allele_string, "/")[[1]]
      return(data.frame(
        rsID = rsID,
        chr = mapping$seq_region_name,
        pos = mapping$start,
        ref = alleles[1],
        alt = alleles[2]
      ))
    }
  }
  return(data.frame(rsID = rsID, chr = NA, pos = NA, ref = NA, alt = NA))
}

# List of rsIDs
rsids <- c("rs12345", "rs67890")

# Fetch data for each rsID
results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(rsids, fetch_variant_data))

# Print results
print(results)

```

#vid_2   modify eqtl vid2 
```{r, echo=FALSE}
eqtl$ID <- gsub("_", ":", gsub("_b38$", "", eqtl$vid2)) 
eqtl_2 <- eqtl %>%
  mutate(
    # Step 2: Extract CHR, POS, REF, and ALT
    CHR = as.integer(sub("chr", "", sapply(strsplit(ID, ":"), `[`, 1))), # Extract CHR
    POS = as.integer(sapply(strsplit(ID, ":"), `[`, 2)),                 # Extract POS
    REF = sapply(strsplit(ID, ":"), `[`, 3),                            # Extract REF
    ALT = sapply(strsplit(ID, ":"), `[`, 4)                             # Extract ALT
  ) 

eqtl_3 <- eqtl_2  %>%
  # Step 3: Filter the data based on conditions
  dplyr::filter( CHR == 5 & eQTL.flag==TRUE
    
   # CHR == 5 & POS >= 132143958 & POS <= 133143958 & eQTL.flag ==TRUE
    #CHR == 5 & POS >= 132143958 & POS <= 133143958 & eQTL.flag ==TRUE
  ) 
fwrite(eqtl_3,"mx_eqtl3.csv")
head(eqtl_3)

fwrite(eqtl_2, "mx_eqtl2.csv")

fwrite(eqtl, "mx_eqtl.csv")
```

4.21e-142 1.81e-140  2.27e-02  9.76e-01  1.00e-03 
[1] "PP abf for shared variant: 0.1%"


Read out posterior probabilities for colocalization:
H0: neither trait has a genetic association in the region
H1/H2: only trait 1/trait 2 has a genetic association in the region
H3: both traits are associated, but with different causal variants
H4: both traits are associated and share a single causal variant
A posterior probability of ≥75% is considered strong evidence of the eQTL-GWAS pair influencing both the expression and GWAS trait at a particular region.

```{r, echo=FALSE}


library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

gwas_data <- rad_meta %>% select(c(POS, P)) %>% rename(pos = POS, pval = P)
eqtl_data <- eqtl_2 %>% select(c(POS, pval_nominal )) %>% rename(pos = POS, pval = pval_nominal)


# Function to create locus comparison plot
create_locus_comparison_plot <- function(gwas_data, eqtl_data) {
  # Merge datasets by position
  merged_data <- full_join(
    gwas_data %>% select(pos, gwas_pval = pval), 
    eqtl_data %>% select(pos, eqtl_pval = pval), 
    by = "pos"
  )
  
  # Calculate -log10 p-values
  merged_data <- merged_data  %>%
    mutate(
      gwas_log_pval = -log10(gwas_pval),
      eqtl_log_pval = -log10(eqtl_pval)
    )
  
  # Create scatter plot
  ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = gwas_log_pval, y = eqtl_log_pval)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = "GWAS vs eQTL P-value Comparison",
      x = "GWAS -log10(p-value)",
      y = "eQTL -log10(p-value)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() 
}



# Create and save the plot
locuscompare(in_fn1=gwas_fn, in_fn2=eqtl_fn, title1="GWAS", title2="eQTL", marker_col1= ID, pval_col1=P, marker_col2=vid2, pval_col2=pval_nominal)

plot <- create_locus_comparison_plot(gwas_data, eqtl_data)
ggsave("locus_comparison.png", plot, width = 8, height = 6)
```
